# Flame v2.6.3

- Automatically list optional LCD and custom clock fonts actually installed in the persistent `data/clock-fonts` directory, while retaining system and bundled Nerd Fonts.
- Accept user-provided TTF, OTF, WOFF, and WOFF2 files, and indicate when a previously selected font is no longer installed.
- Support both `CF LCD 521.ttf` and `CFLCD-Regular.ttf` filenames for CF LCD 521.
- Prevent synthetic bold and italic styling on optional LCD and custom fonts, preserving their original glyph shapes.
- Add a no-store `GET /api/clock-fonts` endpoint, update clock font guidance, and expand Playwright coverage for installed-font discovery.
